youtube.title: RAMESH THAKUR
youtube.summary: Professor Ramesh Thakur examines the global backlash against established political parties, arguing that voters are increasingly rejecting elites who ignore their concerns. He discusses the rise of populist movements, the erosion of trust following Covid-era policies, and whether electoral systems such as NZ’s MMP are undermining democratic confidence. He also warns that leaders who fail to address affordability and voter frustration risk paying a heavy political price. For global news that counts, get RCR Bites FREE every weekday

youtube.title: PAUL BOSHER
youtube.summary: Paul Brennan speaks with dairy farmer and GE Honesty founder Paul Bosher about the future of the proposed Gene Technology Bill following the election. Bosher argues that the reforms could threaten New Zealand’s non-GE and organic export markets, create risks for farmers and undermine the country’s food reputation. He urges incoming MPs to scrutinise the scientific advice, consider the economic consequences and think carefully before allowing the release of GE crops. For further information visit GE Honesty or find them Facebook , X , Instagram and TikTok For everything you need to Say No to Gene Technology
